Planet, Sun, Moon, cloud, ring and Milky Way textures: Solar System Scope / INOVE, https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/ — CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Source maps unmodified; lighting and color rendering applied in the app. Retrieved from the SolarSystemScope source asset mirror in TanvirAhmedArnab/SolarSystem on GitHub. Earth surface: NASA Blue Marble with enhanced ocean colors. These are visualizations, not live observations.
